note: Review fixes of m2-wire (2026-09-26): depth process priority and non-waiting camera hand-off; lag-turn trigger on the ring centre; lead computed without the gap shift. Declarations gap_pilot.json and lag_turn.json version 2 were frozen before every replay and bench below. Report only; not flight evidence. Scripts: session scratchpad m2impl/review-fix/scripts.

starved_depth_process.note: the depth process suspended for 1 s (NtSuspendProcess) while waiting or holding a slot lock; time of the camera-side call

lag_trigger_replay.note: logged ticks of the live flights through the real FastRaceCue in shadow (open loop); a trigger without a ring-centre jump >= trigger_deg is not a checkpoint switch

synthetic_lead_and_gap.note: static course 0 deg, ring 0 -> 12.7 deg left at 10.3 s, gap +12 deg; command heading 0.8 s after the jump

g5_surrogate.note: harness m2impl/lagturn/harness_lt.py, 16 courses, sim seed 17. v2 PD is bit-identical to the original v1 run; v2 brain is bit-identical to a same-day rerun of the pre-fix tree and of the m2-lagturn commit, but the original v1 brain run (2026-09-25 23:37) is not reproducible (same code, checkpoint and profile).

g8_rerun.note: gates v1 unchanged; bench launched below normal and raised after spawning (--parent-priority below-normal); Liftoff open in its seat, GPU 48-51% busy before the runs; fp16 carried over from the first bench (unchanged model, input and weights)

protocol.video: runs/fast-stack-20260923/<flight>.mp4 (1928 x 720 composite; the 1280 x 720 gameplay crop is served), decoded in real time by haltere.liftoff.camera_replay
protocol.gpu: one ChunkGuard chunk per run (<= 300 s): pause above 70 C until 65 C, hard stop at 80 C, temperature polled every 2 s during a run
protocol.conditions: baseline (looming on, gap off), camera (gap in the camera process, every frame), process (separate depth process fed by a frame slot, every frame); camera2/process2 (every other frame) only if both every-frame placements fail
protocol.declared_from: capture_pad_ms: live mss capture stage p50 18.2-22.1 ms (minus-brain08-loom-01, pine-brain08-loom-01, minus-fast6-cur-01, straw-brain08-06); brain_load_ms: live controller step p50 5.5-7.1 ms; camera_fps 48: the runner default
protocol.limits: Liftoff does not run during the bench, so its GPU and CPU load are absent; the replayed frames are the H.264 recording of the capture; the controller is emulated (motion publish, camera polls, a CPU load), not the brain itself

camera_diagnostics.stage_note: publish = cue/retina shared-memory write only (looming split out since the gap wiring)
